candidates.review_note: Nine-position wildcard comparison preserves database order; count and outputs follow exactly the visible contract.
Before deuce the final point is forced and earlier points are unconstrained; after 24:24 every nonterminal pair splits points, then winner takes two.
Rooted BFS gives node-level depth and width. Ascend to LCA; upward edges cost two and downward edges cost one.
Sort by special-friend membership first, popularity second; distinct popularities make output unique.
Let D_i be time from height i-1 to i. D_i=(1+sum(D_j*p_i^(i-j+1),j<i))/(1-p_i). Maintain these sums for the at most 99 nonzero percentage values; sum increments.
Longest feasible common spread duration is limited by each infected run and its boundary position. For that duration each initial infection covers at most 2d+1 consecutive infected cows.
Inclusive age boundaries are 18/35/60. Integer round-half-up computes percentage hundredths and avoids accidental binary-float rounding.
Two-state DP preserves whether elevator entry has been paid; leaving elevator is free and reentry pays c. All travel costs positive so backtracking cannot improve.
Four positive sticks forming three equal sides must have two whole sides of length s and one split pair summing to s. Count unordered choices with multiplicity.
Each full prime power must occur in some factor; separating distinct prime powers minimizes sum. Add unit factors to ensure at least two, including n=1.
